comments.body:
The 300 is a magic number coupled to the `.ui-panel` CSS `transition: 0.3s`. If the transition duration changes, this drifts. `setTimeout` is also a lower bound (throttling pushes it later), stacks on rapid state changes (no cancellation), and the immediate dispatch forces layout thrash mid-transition.

This PR's diff actually **removes** a `ResizeObserver` that was doing this job correctly. L292-L302. Restore it on `#ui-modern-center`:

```js
this._resizeObserver?.disconnect()
this._resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'))
})
this._resizeObserver.observe(document.getElementById('ui-modern-center'))
```

`ResizeObserver` fires when the box actually changes, batched per frame, decoupled from CSS duration. `syncDOMState` no longer needs to dispatch resize at all.
